title: Rorcha — Phase 5: Worktree Manager + Archive + Self-Hosting
description: Complete Rorcha with the Worktree Manager (git worktree lifecycle from the UI), Archive panel (searchable spec history), and self-hosting bootstrap (Rorcha manages its own specs via its own MCP). This is the final phase — Rorcha goes from a tool-you-build to a tool-that-builds-itself. Gate: npm test passes, Worktree Manager creates and deletes git worktrees in target workspaces, Archive panel full-text searches across approved specs, Rorcha's own workspace is registered in its own DB (self-hosting smoke test), npm run build passes, npx tsc --noEmit passes.

userStories.title: Worktree Manager panel — create, monitor, and delete git worktrees
userStories.description:
The Worktree Manager panel gives a full UI for git worktree lifecycle. Replace Phase 2 stub.

File: ~/rorcha/src/panels/WorktreesPanel.tsx

Layout: two-column
- Left: worktree list (scrollable)
- Right: selected worktree detail + actions

Worktree list:
- Fetches GET /api/worktrees?workspaceId= on mount
- Each row:
  ```
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ 🌿 feat/user-auth-oauth     ✓ clean     [›]      │
  │    /Users/me/myapp-user-auth-oauth               │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  ```
  - Branch name (mono, truncated), status badge (clean/dirty/ahead), chevron
  - Path shown as secondary line (muted, truncated)

- 'New Worktree' button → opens inline form at top of list

New Worktree inline form:
- Branch Name: text input (placeholder: 'feat/my-feature', validated kebab+slash)
- Base Branch: text input (default: 'main')
- Worktree Path: text input (auto-filled from branch name, editable)
- [Create] button → POST /api/worktrees
- After success: list refreshes, new worktree auto-selected

Worktree detail (right column):
- Header: branch name (large, mono) + status badge
- Info grid:
  - HEAD SHA (truncated to 8 chars)
  - Worktree path (copyable)
  - Branch: ahead X | behind Y vs base
  - Modified files count

- Modified files list (if dirty):
  - Each file: filename with change indicator (M/A/D prefix)
  - Max 10 shown, '+ N more' if exceeded

- Action buttons:
  - 'Copy Path' — copies absolute worktree path
  - 'Open in Terminal' — stub: shows `cd {path}` command in a copyable code block
  - 'Run Ralph Loop Here' — stub: shows the run-loop.sh command to use
  - 'Remove Worktree' — red button, confirmation dialog
    - If dirty: warns 'This worktree has unsaved changes. Use --force?'
    - Confirm → DELETE /api/worktrees/:encodedPath

SSE integration:
- Subscribe to usePipelineSSE('all') — update worktree list when 'worktree_created' or 'worktree_removed' events arrive
acceptanceCriteria: WorktreesPanel fetches and renders git worktrees from GET /api/worktrees
New Worktree inline form creates worktree via POST /api/worktrees

Remove Worktree shows confirmation dialog, calls DELETE endpoint

userStories.title: Archive panel — searchable spec history
userStories.description:
The Archive panel is a searchable, filterable view of all generated and approved specs across all workspaces. Replace Phase 2 stub.

File: ~/rorcha/src/panels/ArchivePanel.tsx

Backend extension (add to ~/rorcha/backend/src/routes/specs.ts):

GET /api/specs/archive?workspaceId=&q=&status=all&limit=50&offset=0
- Scans both specs/ and specs/approved/ in the workspace path
- Full-text search via q param: matches spec name, story titles, acceptance criteria text
- Sorts by generatedAt DESC
- Returns { specs: SpecSummary[], total: number, hasMore: boolean }

Frontend layout:

**Search bar** (sticky at top):
- Text input: 'Search specs by name, story, or keyword...'
- Debounced 300ms → updates results
- Status filter pills: [All] [Pending] [Approved] [Rejected]

**Results list** (scrollable, infinite scroll or paginated):
- Each result card:
  ```
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ ✅ APPROVED             2025-01-15    8 stories         │
  │ user-auth-oauth                                         │
  │ US-001: User can log in with email...                   │
  │ US-002: User sees error on bad credentials...           │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  ```
  - Status badge (green/yellow/red/gray)
  - Date + story count
  - Spec name (mono, bold)
  - First 2 story titles as preview
  - Click → full spec preview drawer (same as Review Queue detail, slides in from right)

**Empty state**: 'No specs generated yet — create your first in Spec Forge'

**Search empty state**: 'No specs match "{q}" — try a different keyword'

**Spec preview drawer** (right-side panel, 480px, slides over content):
- Full spec detail: title, all stories with acceptance criteria, diagram tab
- Action: 'Re-approve' (if rejected), 'Export JSON' (download .json file)
- Close: X button or click outside

Pagination:
- 'Load more' button at bottom of list (not infinite scroll — simpler, no IntersectionObserver)
- Shows 'Showing X of Y specs'
acceptanceCriteria: ArchivePanel renders search bar with debounced filtering

userStories.title: Phase 5 gate validation — full Rorcha smoke test and final commit
userStories.description:
Final gate: all panels functional, all tests passing, self-hosting confirmed, production build clean.

File: ~/rorcha/backend/src/routes/__tests__/worktrees.test.ts (extends W-001 test file)
Add integration tests:
- Test: full round-trip — POST /api/worktrees → GET /api/worktrees includes new entry → DELETE → GET confirms removal (all mocked)
- Test: GET /api/worktrees/status returns correct shape

Full Phase 5 gate checklist (Ralph documents in story notes):
1. cd ~/rorcha/backend && npm test — all tests pass (W-001, W-005 suites included)
2. npm run dev — all 6 panels render without runtime errors
3. Navigate each panel: Forge, Stack, Queue, Pipeline, Worktrees, Archive
4. Worktree Manager: lists worktrees from a registered workspace (or shows empty gracefully)
5. Archive panel: full-text search returns filtered results
6. Self-hosting smoke test: Rorcha workspace registered, spec generated, approved, visible in archive
7. npm run build at ~/rorcha/ root — completes without errors or warnings
8. npx tsc --noEmit at ~/rorcha/ root — 0 errors
9. cd ~/rorcha/backend && npx tsc --noEmit — 0 errors

Final production-readiness checks:
- No console.log left in production code (grep for them, use proper logger if needed)
- All TODO comments either resolved or filed as known tech debt
- package.json versions pinned (no ^ ranges on critical deps)
- .env.example updated with all env vars from all phases:
  - ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, SPEC_PROVIDER, SPEC_MODEL_ANTHROPIC, SPEC_MODEL_OPENROUTER
  - RORCHA_API_URL, DB_PATH, PORT

Final git commit:
```bash
cd ~/rorcha && git add -A && git commit -m 'feat(phase5): Worktree Manager + Archive + self-hosting — Rorcha complete'
```

After this commit, Rorcha is ready for Phase 4 MCP layer (already written in prd-rorcha-phase4.json).
Run order reminder:
  Phase 1 (engine) → Phase 1b (hydrators) → Phase 2 (UI) → Phase 3 (SSE) → Phase 5 (worktrees) → Phase 4 (MCP)
